verdict.rationale: OpenCode is an AI coding agent operated by natural-language requests. The docs show plain-language prompts via `opencode run`, asking it to fix issues or implement features, @-mentioning agents in messages, and triggering tasks from GitHub comments; community users report using it as their primary harness. missing for 10: an explicit first-party description of the conversational interaction model beyond examples, and independent evidence that natural-language commands work reliably (some users report failed tool calls and stuck agents).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Ask OpenCode to fix an issue or implement a feature. And it will work in a new branch and submits a PR with all the changes.
opencode run "Explain how closures work in JavaScript"
You can also manually invoke them by **@ mentioning** them in your messages.
Mention `/opencode` or `/oc` in your comment, and OpenCode will execute tasks within your GitHub Actions runner.
